Secret metadata only (openbao) (rollup)

Add `dp:SecretEngine`, `dp:SecretPath`, `dp:AccessPolicy`, `dp:RotationState`, `dp:hasRotationState`, `dp:lastRotatedAt`, `dp:currentVersion`, `dp:pathName`, `dp:PolicyPathGrant`, `dp:grantPolicy`, `dp:grantPath`, `dp:grantsCapability`, `dp:leaseExpiresAt`. Touches `crates/eg-core/ontology/data_platform-v1.ttl`. Depends on `EG-DATAPLAT-VOCAB-R001.1`

Add closed shapes (`sh:closed true`) for the five secret-metadata classes, including `dp:PolicyPathGrant`. Allow only their applicable metadata properties, including shared store/provenance links, and reject every other property. Touches `crates/eg-core/ontology/data_platform-v1.shapes.ttl`. Depends on `EG-DATAPLAT-VOCAB-R005.1`

Refusal test row: a `dp:SecretPath` carrying a `value` (and one carrying `token`) triple fails validation, and the vocabulary file contains no property named value, secret, token, password, ciphertext or rules. Touches `crates/eg-core/tests/data_platform_vocab.rs`. Depends on `EG-DATAPLAT-VOCAB-R005.2`

Add a mapping-validator rule that refuses a `dp:StoreMapping` whose `dp:viaOperation` is `openbao_mcp_kv:kv2_get`, `kv1_get`, `openbao_mcp_logical:read` or `unwrap`. Touches `crates/eg-plan/src/virtual_graph_mapping.rs`. Depends on `EG-DATAPLAT-VOCAB-R005.3`

Add a shape: each `dp:PolicyPathGrant` has exactly one `dp:grantPolicy` (`dp:AccessPolicy`), exactly one `dp:grantPath` (`dp:SecretPath`), and at least one `dp:grantsCapability` string in `read list create update delete sudo deny`. Touches `crates/eg-core/ontology/data_platform-v1.shapes.ttl`. Depends on `EG-DATAPLAT-VOCAB-R005.1`
